comment: The pnpm and Bun lines Proscenium supports (#154). The source of truth: the CLI checks manager versions against it, and CI pins the versions it lists. `ci` is the exact version CI runs; `eol` is when the line's owner stops maintaining it. pnpm 10 is not supported (decided 4 October 2026): it leaves a context on an older copy of a shared peer after the app upgrades it, and 11 and 12 do not. pnpm 11 starts at 11.11.0: earlier 11.x let a package spoofing an approved name in its manifest run its build scripts (GHSA-5wx6-mg75-v57r, fixed in 11.5.3) and a tarball's manifest name write outside node_modules (GHSA-vq4v-j7r6-jq4m, fixed in 11.11.0).
